targets.measured: a daily player's 10th creature is 4 levels below the 3rd at week 4; the 6th (a second team's best) is 3 below the 3rd at week 8. A set-and-forget player's creatures of an element their scouts never visit wait at a ribbon gate for shards of that element; an optimiser's spread at week 4 is 4 (pass). It also depends on how fast creatures arrive: at the docs' 2% an hour (the default here is 1.3%) a set-and-forget player's spread at week 4 is 3 (pass) and an optimiser's 3 (pass)
targets.target: within 5 levels at week 4, and two strong teams at week 8

targets.measured: an optimiser visiting three times a day gets 102% of an optimiser visiting once in XP and 102% in posts' and the allowance's output over 24 weeks. In the model extra visits add no rate (idle gains run at the same rate however often a player looks in), so this passes by construction: it shows only that nothing in the rules pays a frequent visitor more, not that choices are worth little
a weekend-off player gets 98% of a daily player's idle growth (effective hours, weeks 1 to 12)
targets.target: about 100% (a weekend off costs almost nothing)

targets.measured: a weekly player's XP per creature, catch-up included, is 83% of a daily player's (idle gains alone: 79%; with fights: 86%; their best creature is level 26 at week 12 against a daily player's 29). Their scouts bring home 41% of a daily player's finds per seat (stores of three days: about 72 of 168 hours)
targets.target: about 75% to 80% of a daily player's XP per creature (goals.md T-2)

targets.measured: a player back after four weeks away keeps every level (best creature +3 levels vs before) and their 3rd-best creature is within 2 levels of the server's middle after 12 days of visits (the target is about 14; if catch-up also boosted fight XP: 6 days)
targets.target: recognises the roster; within about two weeks of daily visits of the server's middle (V-BON-2)

targets.measured: a server of 8 lifts its first place a level on day 4.8; its first collection is done in week 4 (the docs expect weeks 3 to 4) and 4 collections are done by week 12 (no project needs one)
targets.target: first level within 14 days; the rare-find route matters (at least one collection by week 12) without being required

targets.measured: by week 12 a server of 8 has 6 place level-ups across the valley and a fire of 51 if it kills every boss (93 at week 23)
targets.target: about 5 to 6 level-ups by week 12; the fire about 50 at week 12 and under about 100 before week 24 (commons.md)

targets.measured: in the worst week (weeks 2 to 12) a typical player's anvils tinker for want of scrap 0% of the time (daily, week 2)
targets.target: at most 10% for want of scrap

targets.measured: for want of a shard of the element the team needs, the worst week is 67% (weekly, week 2); averaged over weeks 2 to 12 that profile loses 35%. With the Forge floor full the worst week is 39% (weekly, week 12), mean 9%
targets.target: goals.md T-4 names scrap only; shards are shown for the same 10%

targets.measured: 0 of a daily player's 4 resources (Acorns, scrap, shards, Essence) are dead (a pile rising 4 weeks running to 4 weeks of income) before week 12
targets.target: none (resources.md: nothing that only piles up)

targets.measured: a daily player's best creature is level 27 at week 10 and 29 at week 12; it reaches level 30 on day 89
targets.target: still growing in week 12 (example: level 29 of 30), not capped by week 10
